# YouExtractor

> YouExtractor (https://youextractor.me) is an AI developer tool that turns YouTube coding tutorials into complete, runnable source-code projects. Paste a public programming video URL and YouExtractor rebuilds the file tree, dependencies, written guide, and learning roadmap.

YouExtractor is not a YouTube tags extractor, title extractor, description copier, or SEO metadata tool. Those products (often searched as "yt extractor") pull video tags and thumbnails. YouExtractor extracts source code from coding tutorials.
